verdict.rationale: Viam's Registry supplies ready-made drivers that viam-server pulls and initializes from config. Components expose standardized, brand-agnostic APIs (e.g., every camera exposes GetImage(), and sensors follow the same pattern), so hardware can be swapped without code changes. This covers the core of 'ready-made drivers and standard message types', but it is evidenced only through cameras and generic sensors. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of lidar, IMU and GPS drivers or component types; documentation of the specific sensor data formats; independent hands-on corroboration of hardware bring-up.
